# scc_compliance_search_actions (Data Source)

List every ComplianceSearchAction object (Get-ComplianceSearchAction).

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `compliance_search_actions` (Attributes List) All ComplianceSearchAction objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compliance_search_actions))

### Nested Schema for `compliance_search_actions`

Read-Only:

- `action_name` (String) Maps to the -ActionName parameter.
- `change_export_key` (Boolean) Maps to the -ChangeExportKey parameter.

- `region` (String) Maps to the -Region parameter.
- `report` (Boolean) Maps to the -Report parameter.
- `retention_report` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetentionReport parameter.
- `retry_on_error` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetryOnError parameter.
- `scope` (String) Maps to the -Scope parameter. Allowed values: IndexedItemsOnly, UnindexedItemsOnly, BothIndexedAndUnindexedItems.
- `scope_details` (Set of String) Maps to the -ScopeDetails parameter.
- `search_name` (Set of String) Maps to the -SearchName parameter.
